about: Three drawn deep-sky findings and one matched star exactly as the solve of the public corpus photo rp-b-01 (.cache/real-photos, data/downloads.json) served them through the upload path on main 217982b9, for the voice tests of deepsky-answer-1 (FIELD's deep-sky break of 24 Nov).

evidence.verificationMethod: Triangle-matched WCS with held-out residual verification
evidence.distanceUncertaintyNote: Distance interval [94.0, 103.9] pc: 1000/parallax from Hipparcos 2007, with the interval from the parallax error
limitations: Distance is 1000/parallax from Hipparcos 2007, with the interval from the parallax error, not measured from this image.
Its brightness is the catalog's own Hipparcos Hp magnitude, not the usual V.

catalogRef.citation: Catalog id, Hipparcos Hp magnitude and distance: Hipparcos 2007, van Leeuwen (2007) A&A 474, 653.

evidence.verificationMethod: OpenNGC catalog position placed for the recorded time and place by the predicted sky; not measured in the image
limitations: Placed from its OpenNGC catalog centre (OpenNGC v20260501, J2000) for the recorded capture time, its time zone taken from the GPS position and agreeing with the GPS time stamp, and place; not measured in the recording.
An extended object is marked at its catalog centre; its outline is not drawn from the image.
Coordinates printed to 0.15 arcsec in OpenNGC; it gives no accuracy per row.
The centre of a large or diffuse object is a convention, known far less precisely than its printed coordinates.
